baseband_frame.note: Assumed from the kotekan chord branch F-engine convention (channel RF center = coarse_channel_index * 195312.5 Hz at the per-channel DFT DC, first Nyquist zone, upright spectral sense). Unlike CHIME this profile has not yet been verified against measured pilot lines in an operational data product; verify frame convention, sense, and any per-parity decimation twiddle against CRS F-engine baseband before an operational run. channel_center_normalized_odd_channels remains available if a per-parity half-band shift is ever demonstrated.

channelizer_frequency_axis.source_note: Matches the kotekan chord branch CHORD frequency-ID convention: CHORDTelescope FreqParams with nyquist_zone=1 gives freq0=0 Hz and df=+195312.5 Hz, so freq_id == coarse_channel_index and channel 1536 = 300 MHz, channel 7680 = 1500 MHz. Verify against the operational CRS F-engine data product before an operational run.

framing.frame_size_unit: channelized complex samples per input stream
framing.kotekan_frame_note: The kotekan chord configs advance the voltage ring buffer in GPU frames of num_times=8192 samples (41.94304 ms). One detector block is one GPU frame: 8192 samples at K=64 yield windows_per_stream = 128, the frozen fine-reduction transform length (FSTAT_FINE_WINDOWS_PER_STREAM), and the block aligns 1:1 with the 8192-sample n2k visibility integration.

quantization.native_format_note: kotekan chord DataType: one byte per complex sample, offset-binary (stored = value + 8), imaginary component in the low nibble, real component in the high nibble. Conversion to the kernel's two's-complement re-high/im-low layout is a per-byte XOR with 0x88 (subtract 8 per nibble); no nibble swap and no requantization.
quantization.scale_note: CHORD F-engine output is already 4+4-bit quantized upstream (FPGA gains); the receiver adapter performs a lossless encoding conversion only.

channel_id_map.note: The kotekan chordMetadata coarse_freq entries are CHORDTelescope::to_freq_id values; with nyquist_zone=1 these equal this profile's coarse_channel_index directly (freq_id = coarse_channel_index). Populates chord_channel_id / receiver_channel_id in exported runtime bundles.

kotekan_binding.channel_id_metadata_field: chordMetadata coarse_freq (vector<int>, one entry per local frequency)
kotekan_binding.frame_identity_metadata_field: chordMetadata fpga_seq_num plus ring-buffer read offset in channelized samples
kotekan_binding.voltage_buffer_layout: [T, F, P, D] int4x2_swapped_withoffset (time, coarse channel, polarization, dish)

science_band.note: The channelizer grid spans the full first Nyquist zone (0-1600 MHz, 8192 channels); CHORD science channels are 1536-7679. All ATSC 14-36 pilots (470.309-602.309 MHz, channels 2408-3084) fall inside the science band.
